clue.text: Fluff found in 50% of scarves

indicators.note: fifty per cent of a word is its first half, so only the opening four of eight letters are kept

parts.note: mufflers are warm scarves

explanation.surface: Lint is turning up in half the scarves in the drawer.
explanation.definitionFit: To fluff a catch or a line is to bungle it, and a muff is the same kind of fumble.

clue.text: Vehicle turning up outside French station for girl

indicators.note: the turned vehicle goes outside the station, enclosing it
in a down clue turning up means read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: a tram is a street vehicle on rails
gare is French for a railway station

explanation.surface: A bus swings round outside a Paris station to collect a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Margaret is a female first name.

clue.text: Nut many supporting the passion that's found in bed

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits below, so it comes second

parts.note: a fever is a state of passion or excitement
few means not many

explanation.surface: A handful of lovers are bedridden with their ardour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' is a flowerbed, not a sickbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Feverfew is a daisy-like herb grown in garden flower borders.

clue.text: A stain in flying jacket may yield bargain

indicators.note: the stain phrase sits in the word for flying, which serves as its jacket

parts.note: fleet means swift, flying along
a mark is a stain or blemish

explanation.surface: Someone spills something on a pilot's leather jacket and hopes for a discount.
explanation.definitionFit: A street market of second-hand goods is where cheap finds and good deals turn up.

clue.text: Raised over everything, it's plain

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means lifted upwards, so the phrase reads bottom to top

parts.note: on can mean over, upon
all means everything

explanation.surface: Describes a flat landscape elevated above all around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A llano is a broad grassy South American plain, as in Venezuela.

clue.text: Girl liable to change gets ready

parts.note: Ava is a girl's name

indicators.note: the word liable is made to change, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A fickle young woman gets herself prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on hand and free to use is ready for use.

clue.text: Choice of some not obtainable in this case?

definitions.text: Choice of some not obtainable in this case?

parts.words: Choice of some not obtainable in this case?
parts.note: an ultimatum that rules out a partial share: the whole lot or zero

explanation.surface: Asks about a situation where you cannot pick just a part.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a demand for the entire amount with no compromise.

clue.text: In Balkans a stable state can be found

indicators.note: in says the letters are contained within the run of words

explanation.surface: Claims a steady country exists in south-east Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Kansas is one of the fifty US states.

clue.text: Cunning upset university graduate, producing shock

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: art can mean cunning, craftiness
MA is a Master of Arts graduate

explanation.surface: A wily trick upsets a university leaver, leaving them shaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Trauma is a severe emotional or physical shock.

clue.text: Race around very energetically, for starters?

definitions.text: Race around very energetically, for starters?

indicators.note: starters are the opening letters, so each of the four words gives its initial

explanation.surface: A coach suggests sprinting about as a warm-up.
explanation.definitionFit: To rave is to rush about wildly and excitedly, as dancers at an all-night party do.

clue.text: Equivalent of White House in African town?

definitions.text: Equivalent of White House in African town?

parts.words: Equivalent of White House in African town?
parts.note: translate white house into Spanish and you get the name of a Moroccan port city

explanation.surface: Asks where an African city keeps its presidential residence.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moroccan city's Spanish name means white house, so it is literally such an equivalent.

clue.text: Angry with Tory appearance after strikes

parts.note: a black look is an angry one
and means with, together
blue is the colour of the Conservatives, so a Tory is a blue

explanation.surface: A furious Conservative looks the part after industrial action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strikes' suggests walkouts but means blows; Tories are the British Conservative Party, whose colour is blue.
explanation.definitionFit: Being badly bruised is the look of someone who has been hit.

clue.text: Foil pal or become a laughing stock

indicators.note: the letters of the three words turn into something else, a rearranged phrase

explanation.surface: Thwart your friend or end up mocked yourself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'become' is the anagram signal, turning FOILPALOR into the answer; the scan prints laughing-stock with a hyphen.
explanation.definitionFit: The victim of a first-of-April prank is the butt of the joke, someone everyone laughs at.

clue.text: State a lot of paper's left in

indicators.note: the clue says the left letter is put in the paper quantity

parts.note: a ream is a large quantity of paper, 500 sheets

explanation.surface: Complains that much of the paper is still lying about.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a kingdom, a sovereign state or domain.

clue.text: Where student works out, training with reserve

parts.note: exercise is physical training
to book is to reserve, as a table

explanation.surface: Describes a pupil's gym session with a reserve player.
explanation.walkthrough: 'works out' suggests the gym, but here it means solving sums on paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A schoolchild does written sums and tasks in a ruled notebook.

clue.text: Italian phrase in small volume

parts.note: reads as a phrase in a pocket book, but means an expression for speaking quietly

explanation.surface: Points to a foreign expression printed in a slim book.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian term means under the voice, softly, in an undertone.

clue.text: African state whose capital is split

definitions.text: African state whose capital is split

parts.words: African state whose capital is split
parts.note: the country's capital city has a two-word name, Addis Ababa

explanation.surface: Describes a nation whose seat of government is divided.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethiopia is an African country whose capital, Addis Ababa, has a name in two separate words.

clue.text: In style, for instance, church shows refinement

indicators.note: for instance goes in style, contained by it

parts.note: elan is dash, flair or style
eg abbreviates exempli gratia, for instance
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Says that, for example, a church in fashion displays polish.
explanation.definitionFit: Elegance is graceful refinement of manner or appearance.

clue.text: Send round note about fiery manager

indicators.note: send goes round the rest, its first and last letters enclosing it

parts.note: to mail is to send by post

indicators.note: the note is placed about fiery, enclosing it on both sides

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
red-hot means fiery, burning

explanation.surface: Someone instructs a messenger to deliver a note about a hot-tempered boss.
explanation.definitionFit: The head waiter manages a restaurant's dining room and its staff.

clue.text: God .willing, effort initially put into craftsmanship will get notice

indicators.note: the God willing letters and the first letter of effort are placed inside craftsmanship

parts.note: art is skill or craftsmanship
DV abbreviates Deo volente, Latin for God willing

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of effort

explanation.surface: With divine help, hard work poured into a craft will be recognised.
explanation.definitionFit: An advert is a public notice announcing something for sale.

clue.text: Bird soundly placed after lifting eggs.

indicators.note: after says the placed part comes after the lifted eggs
in a down clue lifting raises the word from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: ova are eggs

indicators.note: soundly says the word for placed is heard rather than spelt as written

parts.note: set means placed, put down

explanation.surface: A bird settles down on its clutch after raising the eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocet is a black-and-white wading bird with an upcurved beak.

clue.text: Duke eager to become king

parts.note: avid means eager, keen

explanation.surface: A nobleman is impatient to take the throne.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical king of Israel who slew Goliath bore this name.

clue.text: Poor finale is distasteful

parts.note: off can mean poor in quality, as in an off day
an ending is a finale

explanation.surface: Complains that a show's weak last act left a bad taste.
explanation.definitionFit: Something objectionable or unpleasant gives offence, as a sour smell does.

clue.text: No end of chicken in China is cooked like this

indicators.note: no says the letter that follows is missing from the word

parts.note: china is rhyming slang for mate, china plate, so a friend

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: In China, a bird is never served without its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country but is Cockney rhyming slang: china plate means mate.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicken cooked in hot oil in a pan is done this way.

clue.text: A lilac's one unusual plant

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters being taken out of their usual order

explanation.surface: A gardener notes that one particular lilac is odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Escallonia is a flowering evergreen shrub much used for garden hedges.

clue.text: Rotate flap

definitions.meaning: to turn round and round, as a top does
a panic or state of agitation, as in being in a tizzy

explanation.surface: Turn something round, or a wing that moves.
explanation.definitionFit: Spin means turn round, and a flap or panic is also a spin, as in being in a spin.

clue.text: Deleted, it's rewritten to provide proof of ownership

indicators.note: a text rewritten has its letters set down again in a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe giving no letter

explanation.surface: A clerk says the struck-out passage must be redrafted to prove who owns the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Legal documents conveying land or property establish who holds the rights to it.

clue.text: Sound of welcome heard

indicators.note: heard says the word for welcome is spoken, and another spelling written

parts.note: to hail someone is to greet or welcome them

explanation.surface: A friendly greeting rings out.
explanation.definitionFit: Hale means healthy and robust, as in hale and hearty, much like sound in body.
